caseName: United States Steel Corp. v. Washington
caseNameFull: UNITED STATES STEEL CORP. v. WASHINGTON
attorneys: George V. Powell for appellant., John J. O’Connell, Attorney General of Washington, and Robert L. Simpson, Assistant Attorney General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion for leave to file brief of Berkshire Hathaway, Inc., as amicus curiae, is denied. The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.
